elements.element: No minimum purchase commitment imposed on Customer
elements.evidence: "Customer commits to purchase no minimum amount of Services"; take-or-pay and "without reduction or termination rights" deleted

elements.element: Fees payable for usage or ordered services only
elements.evidence: "and pays only for Services ordered or used"

elements.element: Commitment limited to the current 12-month term
elements.evidence: clause references "in each of the next three years" and creates no term-limited commitment
no notice-based reduction mechanic appears; "without reduction or termination rights" was simply deleted

elements.element: Shortfall addressed by true-up rather than penalty
elements.evidence: no true-up language anywhere in 2.1 or 12.3

reasons: The locked preferred level is fully met: the USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay minimum is replaced with an express no-minimum obligation and payment only for Services ordered or used.
No free-standing reduction or termination right, true-up, or other fallback-only mechanic was imported, so the two bargains are not blended.
Edit is confined to the single offending sentence in 2.1; the residual phrase "in each of the next three years" is inherited from the original and adds no obligation, so the change remains minimal.
Section 12.3, including Vendor's acknowledgement of no minimum-volume commitment, is untouched and now reinforces rather than contradicts 2.1; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics are introduced.
